decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed front porch and convertion of the existing garage into a habitable room would not detract from the appearance of the subject dwelling with respect to the street scene and would not be detrimental to neighbours living conditions or the traffic and pedestrian related amenity of the surrounding area and is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossings and Hardstandings)  of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of single storey front extension and conversion of garage into habitable room for dwellinghouse.
